segmentation: OS Open Roads centrelines (2026-04 release); junction-to-junction strokes of one road cut into round(L/500) equal pieces; independent of crash data
score_definition: expected KSI casualties (DfT severity-adjusted) on this segment, 2026-2027

legacy_column_notes.segment_id: new v2 identifiers (network-based, stable for a network release); v1 IDs are not comparable
legacy_column_notes.location: road, name, distance along the junction-to-junction stretch
legacy_column_notes.n_ksi: KSI collisions in the history window (v1 meaning); casualties in n_ksi_casualties*
legacy_column_notes.n_fatal: fatal collisions in the history window (v1 meaning)
legacy_column_notes.pct_junction: share of history crashes with junction_detail != 0 (v1 definition; roundabouts count as non-junction under the 2024 coding); corrected value: pct_junction_v2
legacy_column_notes.future_ksi, future_fatal: empty: the forecast period has not happened; holdout outcomes are in ml/reports/model_comparison.csv
legacy_column_notes.run: stretch ordinal within road_id (drawing order only); not a risk feature
legacy_column_notes.km_from, km_to: distance along the OS stretch, not an official milepost
legacy_column_notes.blackspot_score: now expected KSI CASUALTIES (severity-adjusted) for the next two years; v1 was an in-sample fit of KSI COLLISIONS

columns_needing_care.eb_excess_ksi_history: expected KSI above similar roads (SPF without traffic) over the history window; a screening signal, not a cause
columns_needing_care.ksi_per_100m_vkm_eb, eb_excess_ksi_expos: only where exposure_available (M/A roads with a matched DfT count point)
columns_needing_care.data_sufficiency: 'sufficient' = >= 6 crashes in the history window; grey out others in the UI
columns_needing_care.single_event_flag: true when one collision supplied >= 5 KSI casualties and >= 50% of the segment's history KSI (mass-casualty events, e.g. the May 2025 Liverpool parade incident on Water Street); label such segments, do not present them as road-design blackspots
